caption:
Missed a math question? Change the numbers and solve it again.

Redoing the same question can just test your memory. A new version with new numbers tests whether you learned the method.

Save this for your next review session.
tiktok_caption: Missed an SAT math question? Change the numbers and redo it.

youtube.title: SAT Math Study Tip: Change the Numbers and Redo It
youtube.description: After you understand a missed SAT math question, change its numbers and solve the new version from scratch to check that you learned the method.
